title: Issues
text: Issues. This is well constructed but there are some issues. The handles are way too small for anyone to get their fingers in there.  I was going to use this for a resin project, but the depth to the bottom of the handle isn't deep enough. The resin will just run out the handle. Not useful for my purposes.

product_metadata.title: Rubber Wood Serving Tray with Handles (17 Inches) – Decorative Serving Trays Platter for Breakfast in Bed, Lunch, Dinner, Appetizers, Patio, Ottoman, Coffee Table, BBQ, Party –Great for Lap &Couch
features: Serve With Style: Serve food on dining tables, bring snacks on coffee table, relish a lazy breakfast on morning or unwind after work in the bathtub, ZESPROKA rubber woodserving tray has many uses.

Rubber Wood Construction: Crafted from premium quality and durable rubber wood, our kitchen serving tray is stronger, sturdier and suitable for everyday heavy-duty use in the kitchen and commercial environments. Probably the last serving tray you will ever buy!

Ergonomic Grip Handles: The sleek and low profile side handles allow for easy carrying of food from the kitchen to living room, patio, bedroom or bathroom. Even if the rustic serving tray is jam-packed with items, you will have a firm grip; never worry about accidents.

Durable Yet Lightweight: Measuring 17.5 inches x 12 inches, this elegant serving tray has the perfect size to fit your favorite foods and yet is lightweight enough for easy carrying when the bed serving tray is full.

Multifunctional Serving Tray: This patio serving tray is ideal for serving breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks and any meal. Apart from everyday use, this serving tray can also be used during family activities, parties and get to gathers.
